title: Service-launch family (service-only manifests)
statement: An APK whose manifest declares NO launchable Activity (service-only) must not render an Activity UI; the engine-default face is CORRECT. A service-launch capability is required before any UI can exist for such apps.
test: stopwatch face byte-identical to no-Activity engine default (0e334abe1b10b592)
notes: OPEN capability gap (by-design blocker for #22), not a runtime bug.
